name: gamenet_send_pkt0c_hud_timer_status_bits
description: GameNet::SendPkt0C_HudTimerStatusBits is a host-only sender that packs timer status bits, broadcasts packet 0C reliably, and applies it locally.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses a fake DirectPlay provider.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x433390 validates the host gate, local-player key and timer seconds packet fields, packed direction/warning bits, resend deadline update, reliable send, and local HandlePkt0C call.
The native GameNet timer-status smoke verifies reliable packet contents, packed direction bit, resend deadline, and local application.
